mu_name_from: MuMain loads glove indexes 10 to 14 from GloveElf{i+1} (ZzzOpenData.cpp line 151: `AccessModel(MODEL_GLOVES + i + 10, ..., L"GloveElf", i + 1)`), so index 12 is GloveElf03, which openmu's 0.75 Armors.cs names the Wind Gloves. Group 10 index 12, Player/GloveElf03.bmd.
why_this_one: The Fairy Elf's third set, sold beside Silk: Elf Lala in Noria carries all five pieces at +3 (src/sim/market.cpp, kElfLala, the index-12 rows). Here so that her shelf shows the pieces it sells rather than their names.
profile_from: Not armour, whose default is plate_steel: nothing in this set is a forged plate. The sheets are blue quilted fabric with a darker blue scroll worked into it, no metal colour anywhere but the Armor's two tan straps. See profiles/soft_armour.json.

stats.note: The item's own row, copied from OpenMU's 0.75 initialiser rather than restated, with the call it came from beside it.
stats.from: openmu/src/Persistence/Initialization/Version075/Items/Armors.cs line 116. The 0.75 table, which is the version this server is being built to.
stats.call_note: ArmorInitializerBase.CreateGloves(number, name, dropLevel, defense, attackSpeed, durability, strengthRequirement, agilityRequirement, darkWizardClassLevel, darkKnightClassLevel, elfClassLevel). Slot 5, so `armor.Group = (byte)(slot + 5)` makes the group 10.
stats.attack_speed_note: Recorded and unread: shared/Combat.cs takes attack speed off the weapon row alone.
stats.defense_note: Points of defence, in the row and summed into Player.ArmourDefense by Wear - see shared/Rows.cs.
stats.classes_from: The last three ints of the call are 0, 0, 1 - the Fairy Elf alone. 80 agility beside thirty strength is the row saying the same thing in stats.

sheet_from: Data/Player/gloves_09c.OZJ (64x64) and hide.jpg, from MuMain. The .bmd names gloves_09c.jpg and hide.jpg; 142 of the 148 triangles are on the first and 6 on hide.
sheet_note: gloves_09c is a blue quilted gauntlet from two sides, the darker scroll up the cuff and a dark palm. Mean (55, 78, 115) at chroma 60. hide caps the opening.
material_note: cloth on all six islands: the two gauntlets at 70 each and four slivers of 2 - gloves_09c's 142 and hide's 6. Blue quilted fabric with the scroll painted in and a dark palm; nothing on the sheet reads as hide or metal.
